Tree listing used to locate the current modes implementation at src/agent/modes.js (older docs reference a mindcraft/modes.json that no longer exists).

Load-bearing: full mode list in priority order (self_preservation, unstuck, cowardice, self_defense, hunting, item_collecting, torch_placing, elbow_room, idle_staring, cheat) with per-mode interrupts; ModeController.update() scans per tick, first active mode wins; mode actions run via runAction('mode:<name>') and interrupted LLM actions get an '(AUTO MESSAGE)Your previous action was interrupted by <mode>'.
Modes do NOT render into the prompt (no $MODES placeholder); getInitModes() only returns profile.modes — evidence that Mindcraft modes gate actions, not prompts.
Base profiles (survival/assistant/creative/god_mode) and prompt settings; no mode-specific prompt mechanism at settings level.
Commands are only actions.js/queries.js/index.js — no modes command, so the LLM cannot toggle modes in current Mindcraft; my proposal extends exactly here.

Strongest industry evidence: PUBG Ally = on-device quantized Mistral-NeMo-Minitron-2B SLM (intent+speech, event-driven) over a behavior tree at game tick rate for movement/aim/combat; 'Reflex-level actions never have to wait for the model'; cloud rejected because latency 'made responses feel too slow for live squad communication'; boundary-between-layers was explicit engineering work.
KRAFTON CES 2025 announcement of the Co-Playable Character (CPC)/PUBG Ally: AI companion enabled by an on-device SLM built with NVIDIA ACE, planned for PUBG IP and inZOI.

DPT-Agent (ACL 2025 main): System 1 = FSM + code-as-policy for fast controllable decisions, System 2 = LLM with Theory of Mind and asynchronous reflection; claims first autonomous success at real-time simultaneous human-AI collaboration.
Official DPT-Agent implementation (MIT): Overcooked Challenge environment, ReAct/Reflexion baselines, webapp for human experiments; System 1/System 2 runnable independently.

'Agents Thinking Fast and Slow: A Talker-Reasoner Architecture' (Christakopoulou, Mourad, Mataric, 2024): Talker (System 1, fast conversational) + Reasoner (System 2, planning/tools/actions); cites modularity and decreased latency.

SwiftSage (NeurIPS 2023 spotlight): dual-process agent — small fast module (behavior-cloned) for routine steps, LLM 'Sage' invoked only on hard states via arbitration heuristic; outperforms SayCan/ReAct/Reflexion on ScienceWorld.

Brooks 1986 subsumption architecture: layered competencies, higher layers subsume lower via inhibition/suppression, parallel AFSMs, 'the world is its own best model'; weaknesses (no memory/learning) are what the LLM system 2 adds.
